tasks.title: Set up project environment
tasks.description: Create a new directory for the project and initialize a version control repository.
tasks.command: mkdir hello-world-web-app && cd hello-world-web-app && git init

tasks.title: Install necessary tools and dependencies
tasks.description: Ensure Node.js and npm are installed, then initialize a package.json file.

tasks.title: Install Express framework
tasks.description: Use npm to install Express.js to quickly set up server-side code.

tasks.title: Create main application file
tasks.description: Write a simple Express server that responds with 'Hello World!' to any request.
tasks.command: echo "const express = require('express'); const app = express(); const port = 3000; app.get('/', (req, res) => res.send('Hello World!')); app.listen(port, () => console.log(`Server running at http://localhost:${port}`));" > app.js

tasks.title: Run the application
tasks.description: Start the Express server to ensure everything is set up correctly.

tasks.title: Test server response
tasks.description: Use a web browser or a tool like curl or Postman to send a request to the server and verify the 'Hello World!' response.

acceptance_criteria: A new directory with a git repository is initialized.
A package.json file is created with Express installed as a dependency.
An Express server is implemented and runs without errors.
Sending a request to the server returns 'Hello World!' in the response body.
